description: SalaryAPI helps signed-in users find annual gross base salary benchmarks, estimate take-home pay from gross salary for supported countries, and check their shared web and chat search allowance. Net salary calculations do not consume that search allowance.

defaultPrompt: Find the median annual base salary for a Senior Software Engineer in Germany.
Check how many SalaryAPI searches I have left and when the allowance resets.
Estimate my monthly take-home pay from a gross monthly salary of 5000 EUR in Bulgaria.
